newsitem.title: USA: UROHEALTH begins 2.5 million share offering.
newsitem.headline: UROHEALTH begins 2.5 million share offering.

text.p: UROHEALTH Systems Inc said it has begun a 2.5 million common stock public offering at $8 per share.
UROHEALTH said all 2.5 million shares are being offered by the company.

The company said it has granted the underwriters an option to purchase up to an additional 375,000 shares to cover over- allotments. Net proceeds will be used to reduce outstanding indebtedness and for general corporate purposes.
Bear Stearns, Piper Jaffrey and Needham & Co are acting as co-managing underwriters for the offering.
